summary: Tested the 4 required radio questions and the new Sexo options on /inscricao.html, at desktop 1920 and mobile 390. Placement: the questionario-fieldset card comes right after the Sexo fieldset. Text is readable. On mobile scrollWidth is 390 and nothing overflows. SEXO now offers MASCULINO, FEMININO, INTERSEXO, OUTRO and PREFIRO NÃO INFORMAR. #btn-salvar stays disabled while any of the 4 groups has no answer and becomes enabled after the 4th. The full flow inscricao -> dados-inscricao -> confirmacao works, and c-sexo, c-estado-civil, c-tipo-em, c-uf-em and c-ano-em show the chosen values. BUG FOUND AND FIXED: the uppercase helper bindUpper also ran on radio inputs. Clicking a radio fires 'input', which turned its value into uppercase (e.g. 'Solteiro' became 'SOLTEIRO'). That uppercase value was saved to localStorage, sent to the backend and shown on confirmacao. Because of that, Alterar Dados / going back to /inscricao.html restored no radio at all (all 4 groups came back empty). Fix made in build_pages.py: radios are excluded from bindUpper, and the restore now compares values case-insensitively. Pages were rebuilt. After the fix, values keep their original case and all 4 groups restore correctly, also after a second round trip. Backend: /api/track/registration saves ESTADO_CIVIL, TIPO_ENSINO_MEDIO, UF_ENSINO_MEDIO and ANO_ENSINO_MEDIO in cadastros.form_data (seen in /admin/cadastros/{cpf}/details). However, the admin export (LABELS in admin_routes.py) and the admin details modal (admin-extras.js) do not show these fields.

minor.issue: LABELS (admin_routes.py ~1178) uses camelCase keys (nome, sexo, estadoCivil, cep...). The inscricao form sends UPPERCASE keys (NOME, SEXO, ESTADO_CIVIL, CEP...). As a result every field prints '—', and the 4 new questions are not in the export at all. The review request says LABELS was updated, but it was not.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: radio values were uppercased by bindUpper, so the restore from localStorage never matched any radio.

integration_issues.issue: admin-extras.js (~line 510) reads camelCase form_data keys (fd.nome, fd.estadoCivil...), so it shows '—'. The new ESTADO_CIVIL/TIPO_ENSINO_MEDIO/UF_ENSINO_MEDIO/ANO_ENSINO_MEDIO are not displayed.

issues: The focused radio shows a light-blue square focus outline around the round radio. Cosmetic only.

Update the admin-extras.js details modal to read the UPPERCASE keys and show the 4 questionário answers.
Keep the tester fix in /app/memory/home_build/build_pages.py (radio excluded from bindUpper, case-insensitive radio restore).

One existing cadastro made before the fix would have uppercase values (e.g. 'VIÚVO'). The tester's test records were deleted.

Run the whole flow in ONE browser_automation script, because localStorage does not survive between runs. test_export_full_contains_questionario fails until LABELS is fixed.
rca of the issue: Root cause: inscricao.html's bindUpper(el) skipped file/select/checkbox/submit but not radio. Radios fire an 'input' event on click, so toUpper changed el.value to uppercase. FormData then saved the uppercase value, and restore searched for [value="SOLTEIRO"] while the page's original value was 'Solteiro', so nothing matched. Mitigation applied in build_pages.py: add el.type==='radio' to the bindUpper exclusion, and match radios case-insensitively on restore.
